title: INGEST.md manifest
description: The shareable-artifact manifest: BLUF, load order, file map, sha256 package fingerprint. One schema for both INGEST.md (canonical) and AGENT-INGEST.md (alias).

package_name.description: The artifact set's name (usually the directory name).

canonical_name.description: The canonical manifest filename (per the two-name rule).

alias.description: The registered alias filename, same schema.

fingerprint.description: sha256 over the artifact set (manifest files excluded), hex-truncated to 16 chars. Recompute after transfer; mismatch = the tree changed.

visibility.description: The package's share posture. OPTIONAL — degrades gracefully.

bluf.description: Bottom Line Up Front: the one-paragraph summary. OPTIONAL.

load_order.description: REQUIRED. The single entry-point contract: the ordered steps/files a consuming agent follows. A reader must be able to consume the package by parsing this alone.

path.description: POSIX-relative path within the artifact set.

file_map.description: REQUIRED. Every file in the set with its size.

video.description: OPTIONAL. Path to the human-facing walkthrough video, if any.

provenance.description: OPTIONAL. Authorship/custody notes; degrades gracefully when absent.

grants.description: OPTIONAL. Access-grant lines for private visibility packages.
